### Alpha Cognition Announces Publication of U.S. Patent Application Relating to Proprietary Manufacturing Process for ZUNVEYL®


**VANCOUVER, B.C., Grapevine, TX, October 13, 2026. Alpha Cognition Inc. (NASDAQ: ACOG)** ("Alpha Cognition" or the "Company"), a biopharmaceutical company developing and commercializing novel therapeutics for debilitating neurodegenerative disorders, today announced that the United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) published U.S. Patent Application No. 19/090,242, titled “Process for Preparing Benzgalantamine and Salts Thereof,” on October 1, 2026, as U.S. Patent Application Publication No. US 2026/0297103 A1.


The published patent application covers Alpha Cognition's proprietary manufacturing technology for benzgalantamine, the active ingredient in ZUNVEYL®. The application includes innovations designed to improve manufacturing efficiency, product quality, impurity control and production scalability, while also covering the preparation of benzgalantamine salts and related pharmaceutical compositions. The disclosed technology is intended to support the consistent production of high-purity benzgalantamine at commercial scale. The application further describes methods for controlling critical product characteristics, which are important for manufacturing reliability and product stability of the ZUNVEYL® franchise.


“The publication of this U.S. patent application represents another step in our strategy to build broad intellectual property protection around benzgalantamine and ZUNVEYL®,” said Michael McFadden, Chief Executive Officer of Alpha Cognition. “The application is focused on manufacturing innovations designed to support consistent product quality, impurity control and scalable production. We believe these capabilities are important to the long-term commercial potential of ZUNVEYL® and our broader benzgalantamine development programs.”


**About Alpha Cognition Inc.**


Alpha Cognition Inc. is a commercial stage, biopharmaceutical company dedicated to developing treatments for patients with neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer’s disease and Cognitive Impairment with mild Traumatic Brain Injury (“mTBI”), for which there are limited or no approved treatment options.


ZUNVEYL is a patented drug approved as a new generation acetylcholinesterase inhibitor for the treatment of Alzheimer’s disease, with expected minimal gastrointestinal side effects. ZUNVEYL’s active metabolite is differentiated from donepezil and rivastigmine in that it binds neuronal nicotinic receptors, most notably the alpha-7 subtype, which is known to have a positive effect on cognition. ALPHA-1062 is also being developed in combination with memantine to treat moderate to severe Alzheimer’s dementia, and as an intranasal formulation for Cognitive Impairment with mTBI.
